steps.en: Install the skill into Claude Code or Codex
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进 Claude Code 或 Codex

steps.en: Point it at your product and ask for a promo, optionally naming shot cards
steps.zh: 把产品交给它并要一支宣传片，可以点名镜头卡
steps.code: Use video-shotcraft to create a promo for my desktop product.

steps.en: Runs a read-only product check and offers three modes: template, autonomous, co-creation
steps.zh: 先做一次只读的产品检查，给出三种模式：模板、自主自由创作、共同创作

steps.en: Pick a mode; the template route means swapping your assets into the Ink Press film
steps.zh: 选一种模式；模板路线就是把你的素材替换进 Ink Press 这支片子里

steps.en: Builds each shot as a Remotion component — real page captures, 2.5D camera moves, beat-pinned SFX
steps.zh: 把每个镜头做成 Remotion 组件：真实截图、2.5D 运镜、卡点音效

steps.en: Renders the finished film to MP4 on your machine
steps.zh: 在你本机把成片渲染成 MP4
steps.code: npx remotion render src/index.ts AiflPromo out/promo.mp4

value.en: A cinematic product film with real screenshots and choreographed motion, without hand-keyframing it in After Effects
value.zh: 一支有真实产品截图、运镜编排到位的电影感宣传片，不用在 After Effects 里手 K 关键帧

sources: README.md Quick start: `Install this skill for me: https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft`, `npx skills add Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft`, symlinks into ~/.claude/skills or ~/.codex/skills
README.md Quick start example requests: 'Use video-shotcraft to create a promo for my desktop product.' / 'Use the deck-deal-flyin and row-embed shot cards to present this feature.'
SKILL.md 调用时先判断模式: three modes (template / autonomous / co-creation), read-only product check first, asks the user to confirm before producing
SKILL.md 四种用法 + 直接使用模板: 读 `template/TEMPLATE.md`
README.md Ink Press: 36.2s validated template, 10 shots, 2.5D real-page camera moves; 'real page captures, 2.5D camera moves, beat-synced cuts, and film-grade SFX'
template/TEMPLATE.md 跑起来: `npx remotion render src/index.ts AiflPromo out/promo.mp4`; `npx remotion studio src/index.ts` for preview
